schema.description:
A model for the router to route across.

**Required:** `name`, and on a gateway router, `provider` for every enabled model.

**Everything else is optional.** A field you leave out (or send as null) gets Emissary's default for the model: its entry in the router model's catalog, which `GET /v1/router-models` lists under `router_models[].models`. Send a field only to override that default, for example your own negotiated prices.

| Field | Default when left out |
| --- | --- |
| `model_id` | Proposal Mode router: the model's `name`. Gateway router: the model's id at `provider`, from the catalog entry's `providers`. No default when the catalog has no id for the provider (`litellm`), so send it. |
| `input_per_mtok`, `output_per_mtok`, `cache_read_per_mtok`, `cache_write_per_mtok` | The catalog entry's prices |
| `context_window`, `supports_vision` | The catalog entry's values |
| `enabled` | `true` |
| `effort_routing_enabled` | `false` |

Defaults are copied into the router when it's saved, and the response shows every field as saved. A later change to the catalog doesn't change a saved router.

name.description: The model's catalog name, which is also the router model's label for it. Must be one the router model lists (`router_models[].models[].name` in `GET /v1/router-models`), and unique within the router.

provider.description: Where the gateway serves the model, with the key you add for it in `providers`. Required for every enabled model of a gateway router; not allowed on a Proposal Mode router. With a provider the catalog entry has no id for (such as `litellm`), send `model_id` too.

model_id.description: The id the model is called by. On a gateway router, what Emissary sends the provider; on a Proposal Mode router, what `POST /v1/route` returns for your app to send. Default, the model's `name` on a Proposal Mode router and its id at `provider` (catalog `providers`) on a gateway router; required for `litellm`, whose ids are your own.

enabled.description: A disabled model stays on the router but is never picked. The router's `default` must be enabled.

input_per_mtok.description: USD per million input tokens. Default, the catalog entry's `input_per_mtok`.

output_per_mtok.description: USD per million output tokens. Default, the catalog entry's `output_per_mtok`.

cache_read_per_mtok.description: USD per million cache-read tokens. Default, the catalog entry's `cache_read_per_mtok`.

cache_write_per_mtok.description: USD per million cache-write tokens. Default, the catalog entry's `cache_write_per_mtok`.

context_window.description: The model's context window, in tokens. Default, the catalog entry's `context_window`.

supports_vision.description: Whether the model accepts images. Default, the catalog entry's `supports_vision`.

effort_routing_enabled.description: Lets the router pick the model's reasoning effort. Takes effect only on a model whose catalog entry lists `efforts`; on any other it's stored off.

extra_fields.description: Per-model overrides, such as `always_on_reasoning` set to true for a model that can't turn reasoning off

schema.title: RouterTargetModelInput
